integrity_notes: Source theorem and zero-order six Fourier coefficient independently reconstructed; exact finite coefficient checks supplement, but do not replace, the Hilbert-space analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Local Dirichlet-distance limit at the monomial orbit; no global stability inequality and no quantitative neighborhood or uniform-in-order bound. Historical priority and external validation are not settled.
title: Sharp sixth-order local stability of the Chang–Marshall extremizer orbit
